entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container from a depot to load it; the cargo is not with Turkon yet.
The loaded container enters the port of loading. After the container has been on a vessel it reads as transit.
Loaded on the vessel, which then sails.
Discharged from the vessel at the port of discharge.
The consignee's trucker takes the loaded container out of the port of discharge.
The consignee unloaded the container and returned it empty. Before the container has been on a vessel it is an unused one and has no stage.
